result.citation: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.3(a)(1) (as amended through Ord. No. 3-26)
result.citation_basis: § 37.3(a)(1) and Ord. No. 3-26 (last entry in § 37.3's history note): O040
result.note: Narrowed the lawyer's § 37.3(a) to § 37.3(a)(1) and added Ord. No. 3-26 because O040, the Rent Board's text of § 37.3, places the annual CPI-based increase rule in (a)(1) with that ordinance last in its history note; the card's own quote stays from D080, a Rent Board news page that is not law text, and no quote is given because O040 itself says it is not the official record (American Legal is the official publisher).
